logline: Dracula Saxo's all-night party at his farmhouse must never see the light of day: the sky goes pink and they run back into the dark house, while a big rig hooks a chain onto it; they board up the windows, but at sunrise the light comes through every gap and they run from each sunbeam on every 'run', the cat lies down in one, and the truck tows the whole house away: the vampires end up sunbathing, belly up, because they're pets.
